description: Horse racing racecards from Sporting Life (UK & Ireland, plus international meetings): today's meetings with course, country, going, surface and weather, and each race's time, name, class, age band, distance, runner count, stage (declared, off, result) and winning time; plus the next ten races with runners (horse, age, form, jockey, trainer, draw, official rating, current and earlier odds) and the betting forecast. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_nascar_racing_reference when you need NASCAR season stats per driver for the Cup, Xfinity; sports_action_network when you need US sports betting lines from Action Network's scoreboard. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Only this country as Sporting Life codes it: ENG, SCO, WAL, Eire, FR, USA…

course.description: Only this course, e.g. Newmarket, Kempton
